_readme: Payload for Elementor's `elementor/build-composition` MCP tool. Apply in order: 1) elementor/manage-global-variable per entry in global_variables, 2) elementor/manage-classes per entry in global_classes, 3) elementor/build-composition with the composition block, against the single-location template, parent_id 'document', mode 'replace_children'. Then add the booking form as an HTML widget inside 'Book Form Slot' (see elementor-templates/README.md). Header, footer and nav are Theme Builder parts and are deliberately not in this composition.

manual_steps.why: No atomic iframe element exists; this is the sanctioned V3 fallback.
manual_steps.action: Drop an Elementor HTML widget inside this div and paste the iframe.

title.content: More customers in Austin. Not more spend.

paragraph.content: Paid ads for businesses across the Austin metro. No lock-in. No vague promises.
Google Ads, Meta, SEO and web
Track record, across every market we work in

title.content: Marketing channels that bring in leads.

paragraph.content: Paid acquisition and the infrastructure that makes it convert. Not a full-service shop doing eleven things adequately.
Local search and map-pack campaigns built around your highest-value services.
Facebook and Instagram campaigns, from new-customer offers to awareness.
Rankings, organic traffic, and a Google Business Profile that looks credible.
Conversion-focused pages with call tracking, so every source is accounted for.
No onboarding portal. No kickoff deck. Four things happen, in this order.
We map your offer, current spend and buying cycle. You give us access to the ad accounts and analytics you already own. Nothing is spent yet.
Tracking and call tracking go in. The landing page goes up. Campaigns are built around your highest-value services, not a template.

title.content: Where we work in Central Texas.

paragraph.content: The Austin metro across Travis, Williamson and Hays counties, including Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Pflugerville, San Marcos, Leander, Kyle and Buda. If you are just outside that list, ask on the audit call.

title.content: How fast can a campaign launch?

paragraph.content: Most accounts go live within one to two weeks of the strategy call, once tracking and the landing page are in place. Your free audit gives you a specific timeline before you commit to anything.

title.content: What does the free audit include?

paragraph.content: We map your current spend, buying cycle and cost of a bad click, then tell you plainly what we would change. It happens before you pay us anything.

title.content: Do you work with competing businesses in the same city?

paragraph.content: We do not offer blanket exclusivity by default. Most clients choose month-to-month specifically because nothing is locked up long term.
